edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, feeding attacker-controlled caller into privileged state.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) authorizes ownership acceptance based on caller-controlled address.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and writes it into owner, transferring privileges.
Parameter _newOwner is consumed by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner state.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership with require(msg.sender == owner).
Parameter _newun is consumed by transfernewun.
transfernewun stores the address into the newun blocker state variable.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)].
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Parameter to is the recipient in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount in transfer.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller the source of value.
transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) arithmetic.
transfer performs balances[to].add(tokens) arithmetic.
Parameter spender is consumed by approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as allowance owner.
Parameter tokens becomes the granted allowance value.
approve writes into the allowed allowance mapping.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the moved amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], using the caller for authorization.
transferFrom performs allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(tokens) arithmetic.
transferFrom reads and conditionally assigns the newun blocker, gating transfers to a restricted address.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter spender is used both as allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is granted as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
Parameter data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller.
approveAndCall writes the allowance mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-controlled external receiveApproval callback.
The external callee can re-enter approveAndCall during the callback.
The external callee can re-enter approve to rewrite allowances mid-execution.
The external callee can re-enter transferFrom to move tokens during the callback.
clearCNDAO trusts msg.sender as the payable beneficiary of the contract balance.
clearCNDAO assigns the local payable variable _owner = msg.sender.
The caller-derived local _owner receives the entire contract balance via transfer.
clearCNDAO executes the balance sweep only when the onlyOwner check on msg.sender passes.
clearCNDAO is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
The empty payable fallback accumulates ether that clearCNDAO later sweeps out.
